resources.string: Notifications are off, so questions won\'t reach you. Turn them on in Settings → Apps → Beadcause.
No browser on this phone to open the console in.
Run npm run qr on the Mac and point the camera at the code.
Server address (or paste the whole pairing URL)
Enter an address and a token, or paste the pairing URL.
That doesn\'t look like an address.
Found the server, but it rejected the token. Check ~/.config/beadcause/config.json.
Couldn\'t reach %1$s — is Tailscale on and the daemon running? (%2$s)
That address isn\'t on a tailnet. Beadcause only sends its token to https://…ts.net — use the link from npm run qr.
%1$s is on the tailnet, but it\'s plain http — the Mac has no certificate yet. Turn on HTTPS Certificates at login.tailscale.com/admin/dns, restart the service, then re-run npm run qr.
This version talks to your Mac over https, and the saved pairing (%1$s) doesn\'t. Scan the code from npm run qr again — the token is unchanged.
